arms.name: entry_confirmation

rules: Protocol fixed before executing these cases. No parameter search, excluded tickers or deleted losing experiments.
Identical 100000 cash, five-session decisions, five-minute monitoring, odd-lot limits and 1% trade risk / 25% reserve across arms.
